name: document-service-management-system
description: Unified single-domain launcher for Document Service Management System (Next.js Frontend + Express API + Socket.IO)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend run prisma:generate && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
